body.date_basis: the exchange's own calendar date when placed
body.est_basis: at the limit price and today's USDAUD=X rate (the fill uses the rate then)
body.fill_rule: Good till cancelled. Fills when the market trades at or through the limit (a buy at or below it, a sell at or above it) in a 5-minute bar of the exchange's regular session that starts at or after the moment the order was placed (daily bars, after the order's own session day, for days more than 55 days back); a bar with neither volume nor a price range does not count. Price: the limit, or that bar's opening price when the market opened through the limit. Every unit fills at once, dated the exchange's date of the bar; FX at the live rate (that day's close for an earlier day); brokerage as entered.
